caseNameFull: Fisher v. City of Berkeley, California

opinions.text: Appeal from Sup. Ct. Cal. Motions of California Association of Realtors and California Building Industry Association for leave to file briefs as amici curiae granted. Probable jurisdiction noted limited to Question 1 presented by the statement as to jurisdiction. Appeal as to Question 2 presented by the statement as to jurisdiction is dismissed for want of a substantial federal question.
